title: 2022年9月四级真题 第1套 阅读2
paperTitle: 2022年9月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
passage:
P1 Remote work is about more than just working from home—it means working differently. Organizations should reconsider the appropriateness of their performance evaluation procedures in light of the shift to remote work. This requires a fundamental rethinking of what organizations expect from employees and what companies would look for in a model employee in a remote work context.

P2 It is likely that the "first to arrive and last to leave" mentality is no longer relevant, but should be replaced by a regard for the quality of an employee's contribution to the organization. This means that work should be measured in terms of the quality of the work, not just the quality of the process. As remote work is largely unobservable to supervisors, employers need to think about how they can objectively measure the quality of work in a way that is consistent for employees of similar rank.

P3 Focusing on output alone can have unintended consequences. Employers should think instead about the values and soft skills they want to emphasize in a remote work environment. Qualities like flexibility and the ability to work under minimal supervision might become critical.

P4 Much has been written about the importance of timely feedback. In the context of a global pandemic(大流行病), firms may want to provide additional support to employees by providing more frequent communication. This allows managers to both keep an eye on struggling employees and provide ongoing feedback on how employees are adapting to their new work environment.

P5 Compensation also needs to be revisited. The purpose of performance evaluation is ultimately to determine how to reward employees for their work. This means that pay structures need to adapt to the reality of working from home. However, organizations also need to be honest with employees about the financial impact of COVID-19.

P6 For organizations that have struggled to keep the lights on due to the pandemic, this might mean thinking of non-financial ways to reward employees, like unpaid time off or flexible work schedules. Employers can also consider how to bundle different types of compensation to help employees cope with their unique situations.

questions.q: What does the author say companies should do in the context of remote work?
options: Reform performance evaluation.
Rethink the organizational fundamentals.
Reexamine its effects on employees' behaviors.
Reflect on its differences from working in the office.
questions.explain:
【判型】What does the author say companies should do 在问作者具体让公司做什么，落点是文 中明示的一条做法，没有 infer / imply / mainly about 之类的字眼，因此走常规定位路径 即可。

【拆句】题干主干是 What does the author say companies should do，what 既是 say 的宾语从 句中 do 的宾语，也是整句的疑问焦点；句尾 in the context of remote work 是介词短语 状语，限定背景。结构平铺直叙，无陷阱。 51. What does the author say companies should do in the context of remote work? A) Reform performance evaluation. B) Rethink the organizational fundamentals. C) Reexamine its effects on employees' behaviors. D) Reflect on its differences from working in the office.

【定位】Organizations should reconsider the appropriateness of their performance evaluation procedures in light of the shift to remote work. 组织应当鉴于向远程办公的转变，重新审视其绩效评估程序是否仍然适当。

【选项】A) ✓ 正确 reconsider the appropriateness of their performance evaluation procedures ↔ Reform performance evaluation Reform performance evaluation 既保留了 "重新审视"（reform）的动作，也保留了 "绩效评估"（performance evaluation）的对象，完全覆盖预判语义。 B) 偷换概念 Rethink the organizational fundamentals 把原文的 "绩效评估制度" 偷换成 "组织根 本"；原文虽提 a fundamental rethinking of what organizations expect from employees，但 fundamental 在原文是修饰 rethinking 的副词性形容词，并非要 "重 审组织根本" 这一对象。 C) 无中生有 Reexamine its effects on employees' behaviors 谈的是 "重新审视远程办公对员工行 为的影响"，原文从未谈论 "对员工行为的影响" 这一对象，只谈对评估制度的影响。 D) 答非所问 Reflect on its differences from working in the office 说的是 "反思远程办公与在办公 室办公的差异"，仅对应原文铺垫句 Remote work is about more than just working from home—it means working differently，没有触及作者真正提出的 "重审绩效评 估" 这一行动建议。 在评估员工远程工作时应优先考虑什么？ A) 他们的产出数量 B) 他们的工作时长 C) 他们的贡献质量 D) 他们工作时间表的灵活性

questions.q: What should be prioritized in assessing employees' remote work?
options: The quantity of their output.
The length of their work time.
The quality of their contribution.
The flexibility of their work schedules.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What should be prioritized 问 "什么应被优先考虑"，问的是一个具体的优先项；无 推断信号，原文必有明示。

【拆句】题干为 What should be prioritized in assessing employees' remote work：被动语态 should be prioritized，主语 what 是被优先项；in V-ing 短语作状语，标明范围。结构直 白，无陷阱。 52. What should be prioritized in assessing employees' remote work? A) The quantity of their output. B) The length of their work time. C) The quality of their contribution. D) The flexibility of their work schedules.

【定位】It is likely that the "first to arrive and last to leave" mentality is no longer relevant, but should be replaced by a regard for the quality of an employee's contribution to the organization. "早到晚走" 的心态很可能已不再适用，应该被对员工对组织所作贡献的质量的看重所取代。

【选项】A) 与原文相反 The quantity of their output 关心的是 "产出的数量"，与原文 the quality of an employee's contribution 中的 quality 形成数 vs 质的直接对立；第三段 Focusing on output alone can have unintended consequences 也明确反对单看产出。 B) 与原文相反 The length of their work time 即 "工作时长"，恰恰是原文 the "first to arrive and last to leave" mentality 所代表的旧心态，被作者明确判为 "no longer relevant"。 C) ✓ 正确 the quality of an employee's contribution to the organization ↔ The quality of their contribution The quality of their contribution 把 but 之后的新标准短语几乎原样搬过来，完全等于 预判结果。 D) 张冠李戴 The flexibility of their work schedules 谈 "工作时间安排的弹性"，对应的是第六段 flexible work schedules，那里讨论的是 "补偿" 而非 "评估优先项"，被嫁接到了第 52 题。 在远程工作背景下，员工的什么素质最为重要？ A) 产出高质量工作的能力 B) 最大化工作效率的能力 C) 及时完成任务的能力 D) 在最少监督下工作的能力

questions.q: What quality in the employees would be of great importance in a remote work context?
options: The ability to produce quality work.
The ability to maximize work efficiency.
The ability to finish tasks in a timely manner.
The ability to work with the least supervision.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What quality ... would be of great importance 问的是一项被作者点名为重要的素 质，原文必有明示项。

【拆句】题干主干 What quality in the employees would be of great importance in a remote work context：what 修饰 quality，构成疑问焦点；in the employees 与 in a remote work context 都是 in 短语作定语 / 状语；would be 是表 "一般陈述" 的虚拟语气。无 陷阱。 53. What quality in the employees would be of great importance in a remote work context? A) The ability to produce quality work. B) The ability to maximize work efficiency. C) The ability to finish tasks in a timely manner. D) The ability to work with the least supervision.

【定位】Qualities like flexibility and the ability to work under minimal supervision might become critical. 诸如灵活性以及在极少督导下工作的能力之类的素质可能会变得至关重要。

【选项】A) 张冠李戴 The ability to produce quality work 谈 "产出高质量工作"，回到的是第二段 the quality of the work，与第 52 题答案重合；第三段开头 Focusing on output alone can have unintended consequences 已明确不再单看产出。 B) 无中生有 The ability to maximize work efficiency 提出 "工作效率最大化"，原文从未出现 efficiency 或与之对应的概念；远程办公段也未谈效率优化。 C) 张冠李戴 The ability to finish tasks in a timely manner 谈 "按时完成任务"，把第四段的 timely feedback 嫁接到第三段；原文谈的是反馈要及时，并非要求员工按时交付。 D) ✓ 正确 the ability to work under minimal supervision ↔ The ability to work with the least supervision The ability to work with the least supervision 与预判 "在极少督导下工作的能力" 在 动词、对象、形容词强度上一一对应。 为什么在疫情期间公司提供及时反馈很重要？ A) 以一致的方式评估级别相近的员工 B) 密切关注那些表现不佳的员工 C) 帮助有需要的员工适应新的工作环境 D) 与远离办公室的员工保持联系

questions.q: Why is it important for firms to provide timely feedback during the pandemic?
options: To evaluate their employees of similar rank in a consistent way.
To keep a watchful eye on those employees who perform poorly.
To help employees in need adapt to the new work environment.
To maintain connections with their employees away from office.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 Why is it important for firms to provide timely feedback 问 "为何及时反馈很重 要"，原文必然存在与之对应的 "to do / so that / in order to" 类目的句。

【拆句】题干 Why is it important for firms to provide timely feedback during the pandemic： 句型 "why is it important for sb to do sth"，it 是形式主语、to provide 是真正主语； during the pandemic 介词短语作状语限定时间。无陷阱。

【定位】This allows managers to both keep an eye on struggling employees and provide ongoing feedback on how employees are adapting to their new work environment. 这样做既能让管理者关注陷入困境的员工，又能持续就员工如何适应新的工作环境提供 反馈。 54. Why is it important for firms to provide timely feedback during the pandemic? A) To evaluate their employees of similar rank in a consistent way. B) To keep a watchful eye on those employees who perform poorly. C) To help employees in need adapt to the new work environment. D) To maintain connections with their employees away from office.

【选项】A) 张冠李戴 To evaluate their employees of similar rank in a consistent way 谈 "以一致方式评 估同级员工"，对应的是第二段 in a way that is consistent for employees of similar rank，那里讲的是绩效度量、不是反馈目的。 B) 以偏概全 To keep a watchful eye on those employees who perform poorly 只对应原文 keep an eye on struggling employees 这一半目的，遗漏了 provide ongoing feedback on how employees are adapting；而且 perform poorly 把中性词 struggling 偷换成 了带负面评价的 "表现差劲"。 C) ✓ 正确 provide ongoing feedback on how employees are adapting to their new work environment ↔ To help employees in need adapt to the new work environment keep an eye on struggling employees ↔employees in need To help employees in need adapt to the new work environment 同时命中原文目的 中的两个核心元素——struggling employees（in need）与 adapting to their new work environment（adapt to the new work environment）。 D) 无中生有 To maintain connections with their employees away from office 谈 "维持与异地员 工的联系"，原文从未把 timely feedback 的目的描述为 "维持联系"，连 connection 一 词都没出现。 作者对经历疫情财务影响的雇主有什么建议？ A) 敦促员工适应新形势 B) 以非常规方式奖励员工 C) 识别贡献甚微的员工 D) 允许员工寻找兼职工作

questions.q: What is the author's suggestion to employers who experience the financial impact of the pandemic?
options: Urging their employees to adapt to the new situation.
Rewarding their employees in unconventional ways.
Identifying employees who make little contribution.
Allowing their employees to look for part-time jobs.
questions.explain:
【判型】题干 What is the author's suggestion 问一条明示的建议，落点具体，无推断信号词。

【拆句】题干 What is the author's suggestion to employers who experience the financial impact of the pandemic：主干 "What is the author's suggestion"，to employers 是 suggestion 的对象状语，who 引导定语从句修饰 employers。结构略长但逻辑清晰，无 陷阱。 55. What is the author's suggestion to employers who experience the financial impact of the pandemic? A) Urging their employees to adapt to the new situation. B) Rewarding their employees in unconventional ways. C) Identifying employees who make little contribution. D) Allowing their employees to look for part-time jobs.

【定位】For organizations that have struggled to keep the lights on due to the pandemic, this might mean thinking of non-financial ways to reward employees, like unpaid time off or flexible work schedules. 对于那些因疫情挣扎着维持运营的组织而言，这或许意味着要考虑用非财务的方式来奖励员 工，比如无薪假期或弹性工作安排。

【选项】A) 张冠李戴 Urging their employees to adapt to the new situation 把建议的发出对象与动作都改 了：原文要求雇主 "改用非金钱奖励"，而本项变成 "催促员工适应新形势"。adapt to the new situation 又把 adapting to their new work environment 拼贴过来。 B) ✓ 正确 non-financial ways to reward employees ↔ Rewarding their employees in unconventional ways Rewarding their employees in unconventional ways 既保留了原文的核心动作 reward，又把 non-financial 抽象到 unconventional，与预判 "用非金钱 / 非常规方式 奖励员工" 完全合拍。 C) 无中生有 Identifying employees who make little contribution 谈 "识别低贡献员工"，原文从 未提出在疫情下要 "挑出低贡献员工" 这种建议；contribution 一词只在第二段衡量标准 中出现，与第六段建议无关。 D) 过度推断 Allowing their employees to look for part-time jobs 谈 "允许员工找兼职"，原文虽 提到 unpaid time off or flexible work schedules，但没有任何 "找兼职" 的建议；二 者不可等同。
